name: Telegram
description: Texts from byob on your phone through a Telegram bot of your own: routines tell you what they found, ask you to approve things with Yes/No buttons, and you can reply. Free; byob only reads the bot's messages by asking Telegram for them (no open port). Off until you add your bot's token.

settings.label: Bot token
settings.help: Make a bot of your own (about 2 minutes): open Telegram, search for @BotFather and start a chat with it, send /newbot, pick a name (anything, like "My byob") and then a username that ends in "bot" (like my_byob_bot). BotFather answers with a token that looks like 123456789:AAE…; copy it and paste it here. Keep it secret: anyone with it can use your bot.
